title: Nienna

imageCaption: Nienna — explorer, survivor, and bearer of Hope.
dek: A frightened woman who learned that survival can be wise, then recognized the rare moment when her own life truly was hers to spend.

body:
Nienna’s choices continue to affect people after her death. She survives a retreat whose morality remains unresolved and later, in a different crisis, chooses to spend the life she had learned was worth preserving. These decisions do not form a simple ascent from cowardice to courage: her final act changes how the earlier flight can be understood without proving that it was wrong.

Core distinction: Nienna does not learn that survival is shameful. She learns that survival has value—and therefore understands the price when she finally chooses to spend it.

The expedition to Gael

Nienna acquired a ship and freed or sprung its crew, then joined the chain of discoveries that reached Gael by June 2024. She said she would have attempted the journey alone and believed the Void would have killed her. Her testimony also preserves one horrific crossing method in which unwilling souls were fed to the Void’s inhabitants; it does not establish that all historical travel worked that way.

I would have come alone you know. And I would have met my end. Alone, in the void, cold and alone.Nienna

Jiangshi and the wound in her self-conception

After Jiangshi is lost, Nienna does not discuss cowardice as an abstraction. Adelia and Bitoshi blame her for leaving. She reports that Nuru—the god of her people, whom she once worshipped—looked on the others with approval and named her a “pathetic coward.” Nienna does not dismiss the judgment as cruelty. She fears it reveals what she truly is.

This is about Nuru seeing the true condition of my heart.Nienna

The archive preserves the attribution carefully: this is Nienna’s report of Nuru’s judgment and Nienna’s belief about herself, not an objective verdict from the Codex.

Gartina’s defense of retreat

Gartina refuses the easy answer that brave people never run. Returning for Jiangshi would probably have produced another corpse and left both bodies unrecoverable. “Never leave an ally behind” can turn loyalty into pointless death; knowing how, why, and when to flee may be knowledge that other people lack.

This defense keeps the earlier event morally open. The Jiangshi retreat and Nienna’s later sacrifice answer different circumstances. Her death does not prove Adelia, Bitoshi, or Nuru right, and it does not prove Gartina wrong.

July 2024 · first death and Raise Dead

After defeating a fire-and-ash bird in the Plains of Trial, Nienna and Saray choose to keep hunting. When soul eaters and wraiths approach, they decide to stand. Nienna places herself in front of Saray and repeatedly urges her to escape if she falls. A soul eater strikes Nienna down; she dies while Saray fights on. The narration posted on 9 July confirms her death, Saray defeating the remaining enemies and the recovery of Nienna’s body to the Tower.

The community’s first response is grief and a search for the means to restore her. Saray blames herself, but her guilt is her own judgment of the encounter. On 15 July, she petitions Nuru’s messenger and makes an offering of husks and gold at the altar. A diamond appears, and she carries it to Elenia.

Elenia presses the diamond into Nienna’s arm and prays, casting Raise Dead. Nienna wakes abruptly and fires two firebolts into the wall, still reacting as though the fight continues. Elenia embraces her and reassures her that Saray brought her home. Realizing she is alive, Nienna recalls the creatures fighting her for her soul.

This first death and return precede her voluntary sacrifice during the September Hallowing. The July recovery depends on Saray bringing her home and securing the diamond, and on Elenia’s casting. It does not remove the cost of the later choice.

The Hallowing of Hope

During the Hallowing, Nienna does not become fearless or abandon the instincts that once kept her alive. She behaves tactically, conserves resources, remembers where danger came from, trusts defenses, and tries to survive. When the Gate threatens everything, the situation changes. She draws the enemy away and runs toward the place where spending her life can preserve Hope and allow the others’ work to continue.

Please, let me run.......one last time.Nienna

The repeated action carries the transformation: she does not become courageous by ceasing to run. She decides what she is willing to run toward. Nienna crosses the Gate and spends her life on 6 September 2024, creating an opportunity for Hope to survive rather than guaranteeing victory. The closing quest narration confirms that her companions finish the Hallowing afterward and life spreads from the tree. What lies beyond her final farewell remains outside the surviving company’s view. Read the full Hallowing story →

A sacrifice she owns

Nobody selects Nienna as an acceptable casualty. She identifies the price herself and acts so that the people who love her cannot overrule her. Its moral force comes from agency: the life being spent belongs to the person spending it. Her act therefore stands against systems in which powerful figures volunteer other people for a future they have chosen.

She also wants to live. Her farewell is affectionate, frightened, hopeful, and still reaching toward a future she will not see. That desire makes death a real price rather than a dramatic pose.

Dale, maybe if you have a daughter.......name her after me?Nienna
You’re foolish, Miss Nienna, but oh so brave.Dale

Her answer to Death

Death declares that nobody will come to her aid. Nienna does not answer with greater power or guaranteed rescue. She dies, but refuses to let death decide whether everyone else’s story continues.

Fight on. This is not the end. See you in another life.Nienna

Consequence outlives presence

Elenia continues to care for others through her grief rather than treating attachment as a mistake. Dale carries Nienna’s memory. Saray’s guilt and later choices remain connected to the loss. Their accounts of Nienna’s decision shape how Hope, courage and the continuation of life are understood.

Later accounts name Nienna beside Hope’s living builders, preserving her contribution alongside the work of those who survived. Her choice is remembered, and that memory informs later choices.

Record boundary

The supplied “favorite character” essay is an explicitly interpretive reading, not objective canon. Its strongest synthesis is preserved here because it fits the recovered scenes, but its preference remains the analyst’s. The Codex does not declare Nienna one of the world’s “best” characters, retroactively condemn her retreat, or turn her sacrifice into a universal rule for anyone else.

Scenes in sequence

These selected scenes preserve what was knowable when people acted. Dates below identify source postings in UTC; they do not supply an in-world calendar. A later appearance does not settle present status.

  1. 2024-06-13 · compatible RP

    An expedition begins with a personal decision

    Gartina credits Nienna’s ship and crew with making the expedition possible.

    Known at this stage
    This is Gartina’s account of the expeditionary chain and of why she joined.
    Consequence
    Nienna’s initiative matters alongside the people who sailed, fought and sustained the venture.
    Still unresolved
    The speech does not make Nienna the sole restorer of Gael.

    Receipt 1

  2. 2024-07-09 · compatible RP

    A fatal stand on the Plains of Trial

    Nienna stands before Saray against soul eaters and wraiths. She dies during the fight; Saray defeats the remaining enemies and brings her body to the Tower.

    Known at this stage
    The two choose to stand after continuing their hunt; no one has secured a return from death.
    Consequence
    Saray survives and recovers Nienna’s body, making the later effort to restore her possible.
    Still unresolved
    Nienna’s warning to flee and Saray’s later guilt do not establish an objective allocation of blame or permanent destruction of Nienna’s soul.

    Receipt 1 · Receipt 2 · Receipt 3 · Receipt 4 · Receipt 5 · Receipt 6

  3. 2024-07-15 · compatible RP

    Raise Dead at the Tower

    Saray obtains a diamond through an altar offering. Elenia casts Raise Dead, and Nienna wakes in alarm before being reassured by her friends.

    Known at this stage
    The diamond has been obtained after the community’s earlier uncertainty about materials and help.
    Consequence
    Nienna is alive again before the separate Hallowing; Saray’s recovery work and Elenia’s casting both matter.
    Still unresolved
    The spell record follows the awakening in posting order but documents the same return. This does not describe the separate September sacrifice.

    Receipt 1 · Receipt 2 · Receipt 3 · Receipt 4 · Receipt 5 · Receipt 6 · Receipt 7 · Receipt 8 · Receipt 9

  4. 2024-09-06 · quest

    Time bought for the Hallowing

    Nienna turns toward the horde after her farewell. The later narration records the Hallowing completing and life expanding.

    Known at this stage
    She acts while the casters still need time; the completed spell lies ahead of her choice.
    Consequence
    Her final defense and the casters’ sustained work belong in the same history.
    Still unresolved
    The Hallowing does not establish a universal rule for sacrifice or resurrection.

    Receipt 1 · Receipt 2

profile.personality: Nienna is brave enough to appear reckless and responsible enough to know when courage must become retreat. She carries grief openly, treats hope as more important than personal survival, and refuses to let love become an excuse for sacrificing everyone who remains.
profile.achievements: She helps build Pristinia’s defenses, brokers the wolves’ survival pact, secures a crew and ship, reaches Gael through a terrible interregional journey, and later gives herself so Hope can live. Her history also includes captivity, command under impossible pressure, death, memory, and a legacy that continues through Adelia and Hope.
profile.relationships: Dale, Gartina, Elenia, Adelia, and Jiangshi shape her most consequential choices. Gartina defends her when the Gael retreat is called cowardice; Dale receives her farewells and admiration; Elenia is one of the people she trusts to finish the work; and Jiangshi’s loss ensures that Nienna’s command decisions remain morally alive long after the battle.

sourceReview.scope: Selected Nienna first-death, diamond-offering and Raise Dead evidence checked against the supplied original scenes and compatible intervening quest testimony. Other history retains its own evidence.
